title: Open the front door
scenario: "Launch day: portal.edymonte.com.br must serve HTTPS through Front Door, and nobody may bypass it to hit the cluster directly." — CTO
mission: Apply the edge layer, serve both hosts with managed certificates and lock the origin to your Front Door profile.
objectives: Explain Front Door vs App Gateway vs Traffic Manager

prerequisites.notes: Front Door has an hourly base fee — do this session in one sitting and destroy 50-edge after C026.

cost: ≈ US$1.20/day Front Door Standard + WAF. Destroy after the edge sessions.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: Read the plan; custom domains and routes.

steps.title: Lock the origin
steps.detail: Only requests with your profile's X-Azure-FDID reach the ingress (lab 10 challenge).

criteria.text: Both hosts answer HTTPS with a valid certificate
Requests without your Front Door ID are rejected by the origin
Direct access to the ingress IP from outside is blocked

expectedResult: A single, protected public entry point.

concepts.title: Edge services
concepts.body: *Front Door* is a global HTTP(S) entry point with CDN, TLS and WAF. *Application Gateway* is a regional layer-7 load balancer inside a VNet. *Traffic Manager* is DNS-based routing between regions. They can be combined.

concepts.title: Origin lock
concepts.body: Allowing the `AzureFrontDoor.Backend` service tag only proves the request came from *some* Front Door. Each Front Door profile adds an `X-Azure-FDID` header with its own id; the origin checks it to accept only YOUR profile.

glossary.def: Backend that Front Door forwards requests to.
TLS certificate issued and renewed by Azure after DNS validation.

recovery: Certificate pending: the DNS validation TXT record must exist in the Azure zone (Terraform creates it).
dont: Do not leave Front Door running for days
Do not open the NSG to Internet
hints: The AzureFrontDoor.Backend service tag is shared by all customers.
Front Door adds X-Azure-FDID with your profile id.
An ingress annotation or NGINX snippet can check the header.

interview.question: How do you stop clients from bypassing Front Door?
followUps: Front Door vs Application Gateway — when combine them?

debrief: Service tag filtering limits sources to Front Door infrastructure, not your profile. The X-Azure-FDID check (or Private Link origins on Premium) binds the origin to your profile.
